notes: ACCESS: HTTP-first tier (a) only - curl_cffi (impersonate=chrome) direct fetch of robots.txt, homepage HTML, collections.json, and per-collection pages/products.json. robots.txt is a Shopify storefront default (User-agent: * / Allow: /) with no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow, so tier (a) was fully sufficient; no Playwright/Chrome needed. TREE: parsed the server-rendered mega-menu (#main-nav) from the homepage HTML with BeautifulSoup to get the full department > group > sub-category structure (Living, Lighting, Dining, Outdoor, Decor, Bedroom, Workspace, Brands, Inspiration, Sale). Cross-checked collections.json (750+ collections total across 3 pages) but that list is dominated by legacy/promotional artifacts (individual designer names, price-range buckets, expired sale campaigns) so the live mega-menu was used as the authoritative tree, not the raw collections list. Confirmed each recorded leaf's <title> tag and canonical link matched the requested handle (no silent parent/whole-site fallback). Also checked and excluded several stray Bath/Bathroom collections (bath-towels, bath-mats, bathroom-accessories, etc.) found in collections.json - none are linked from the mega-menu, no footer nav exists on this theme, and no category page's own sub-strip references them, so they read as orphaned/inactive collections rather than a live navigational Bath department; excluded per the anti-orphan-collection principle. QTY: used the Shopify collection page's own rendered pagination string ("Showing 1-N of TOTAL", element class collection-pagination__count-total) as the exact qty; cross-verified low counts against /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 (Blankets returned 0 products both ways, confirmed as a genuine zero-product live category, not a fabricated one). DEDUP: several sub-categories are linked identically from multiple departments (Rugs/Throw Pillows/Throws/Wall Shelves & Ledges under Living+Bedroom+Workspace all resolve to the same URLs; Baskets & Bins under Decor+Bedroom is the same URL; Hooks Racks & Stands (Bedroom) and Hooks, Racks & Coat Stands (Decor) are different URLs but verified via products.json to contain the identical 112-item product set) - each was recorded once, under its first nav occurrence, and later duplicates were dropped rather than re-emitted. EXCLUDED (Furniture per storage.md Storage-Furniture-Boundary/section 21, explicit case-goods sold as furniture, not organizers): Bookcases & Standing Shelves, Cabinets & Cupboards, Media Cabinets, Sideboards & Credenzas, Beds, Dressers & Wardrobes, Nightstands. EXCLUDED (Wall Decor per storage.md section 18): Wall Shelves & Ledges (explicit Wall Ledge boundary example). EXCLUDED (not storage - serving/dining purpose per storage.md section 20/26): Bar Carts & Trolleys, Decorative Trays & Bowls, Serveware, Dinnerware, Flatware. EXCLUDED (not storage - primarily whiteboards/pinboards, verified via products.json, not organization items): Office Supplies collection. EXCLUDED (decorative, not storage, per storage.md section 24): Vases, Planters, Figurines & Ornaments, Candles & Candle Holders, Clocks, Mirrors, Artwork. EXCLUDED (Lighting): all Lighting department nodes. Linens & Napkin Holders (Dining > Tabletop & Bar) is a small mixed collection (2 of 3 products are genuine textiles - napkins and placemats - the third is non-textile napkin rings, akin to curtain-ring hardware); included as Textile with confidence LOW and a flag noting the mixed content rather than being force-excluded or force-included at HIGH confidence. Wine Racks and Wastebaskets have no exact keyword match in storage.md's example lists but were included as Storage at MEDIUM confidence because the website itself places them under an explicit 'Storage' / 'Storage & Organization' heading and their primary function is genuine containment/organization (wine-bottle storage, waste containment) rather than decorative display.
